# Export the report

## Your task

Copy the blank template to the repository root:

```bash
cp templates/learner-report.qmd my-study-report.qmd
```

Fill the prompts with your own results. For outputs in `results/my-study/`, update figure paths in the copied report accordingly.

```bash
quarto render my-study-report.qmd --to html
```

## Expected output

An HTML report with question, inputs, methods, figures, verification, limitations, and AI assistance. Use browser Print → Save as PDF if needed.

## Check before continuing

Check that every figure loads and every statement matches your generated tables. Include the generated `session-info.txt` for reproducibility.

## Continue to shotgun metagenomics

You’ve compared community composition and seen how the distribution of feature counts affects Shannon diversity. What can a functional profile tell you about the community?

In the next example, you’ll compare LPS transport values across three blood pressure groups. Check whether a few high values reflect a shift in the typical sample by comparing the group medians and the overlap between samples.
